edit.description: everyMatch re-spells a declared title pattern without the sticky flag

summary: everyMatch keeps a declared title pattern's `y` flag, so a sticky lane reader silently answers a short or empty title set
acceptance: A lane declaring a sticky title pattern answers the same titles the same pattern without `y` answers, over the whole shed log.
tests: a lane's sticky title pattern reads every failing title the log states
notes: everyMatch (harness/ci.ts:420) adds `g` and keeps every other flag. With `y` kept, matchAll anchors each step at lastIndex and stops at the first gap: measured, /FAIL (\w+)/y over a log whose first match is not at index 0 answers []. That empty set is exactly the silent degradation readTitles (:402) says it must not yield, and the head's claim at :81 — over every match, whatever flags it carries — is false for `y`.
